legacy_root.title: Stopping-expression grammar and static validation (CNL-0010)
legacy_root.description: Typed-tree grammar for CouncilSpec stopping expressions covering AND / OR / NOT plus ANY, ALL and weighted forms, with parse-time static rejection of unbound variables, never-satisfiable conjunctions, and always-true tautologies. SUCCESS:CNL-0010

x-cnl-0010.question: What grammar covers AND / OR / NOT plus ANY, ALL and weighted forms, and which expression errors (unbound variable, never-satisfiable conjunction, always-true tautology) can be caught STATICALLY before a single round runs?
x-cnl-0010.answer: A typed JSON tree with ops cmp, var, not, and, or, any, all, weighted, plus an infix surface language with precedence NOT > AND > OR. All six catalog-quoted executable examples parse (6/6). Static analysis over the declared metric registry rejects UNBOUND, UNSATISFIABLE (x AND NOT x), and TAUTOLOGY (p OR NOT p) before any round. Cited v1 file 11-COUNCIL-SPECIFICATION.schema.json is ABSENT on this worktree. CNL-0001 reconstructs v1 $defs.stopping_expr as a non-empty string: that string schema stores all 6/6 example surfaces and structurally types 0/6 (opaque string has no AND/OR/NOT/ANY/ALL/weighted operators) and is silent on 'x AND NOT x' (v1_string_silent_on_unsat=True). In-tree stopping objects (max_rounds/on_timeout at command-center/p2-wave/probes/ARC-0010/registry.schema.json) express 0 of 6 and cannot express 6 of 6. Live platform/schema/councilspec.schema.json has $defs.stop_expression (not the cited name stopping_expr) which schema-accepts 6/6 mapped trees and is silent on unsat (unsat_tree_accepted_by_schema=True); static UNSAT/TAUTOLOGY/UNBOUND is this unit's addition.

grammar.surface: infix; NOT tightest, then AND, then OR; ANY(k, ...)/ALL(...)/WEIGHTED(threshold, w * expr, ...)

not_caught_here: runtime flapping after a predicate becomes true then false (CNL-0076)
whether a bound metric's producer is honest (gameable-metric units)

live_councilspec_stop_expression.note: Live CouncilSpec uses $defs.stop_expression (all_of/any_of/not/weighted + typed leaves), not the cited v1 name $defs.stopping_expr. JSON Schema rejects unknown metric names (x AND NOT x) but accepts well-typed never-satisfiable trees (unanimity AND NOT unanimity). Static UNSAT/TAUTOLOGY is this unit's addition.

v1_reconstructed_string_store.note: opaque string can hold every surface; it cannot type operators
